correctness.rationale: The identity gives B(1)=1 and B(z)=1 or z. In the first case B descends to a homomorphism V=Q/Z -> Q and necessarily lands in Z; in the other case C(g)=gB(g) descends to such a homomorphism. Conversely the two formulas satisfy the exact group RB identity. Counting Hom(V,Z) gives exactly 8 and disjoint families. Aut(Q) surjects onto GL2(F2), giving 1,3,1,3 orbits. The involutive inverse-twisted map formula establishes dual and image assertions; uniqueness of the quaternion involution proves the splitting criterion. Exhaustive C++17 checked all 8^7 normalized functions with independent Python formula check. Both executed successfully.
